packageSize.notes: Canary regression guard after moving heavy runtimes and the Superset CLI to on-demand resource packs. Published installer artifacts should stay well below 200 MiB; 300 MiB is the hard rollback line.

startup.notes: Phase 0 regression guard for packaged-app startup marks. Replace perf-baseline.json with measured canary values after the first baseline capture.

runtime.notes: Phase 0 dev/canary process-tree guard. maxBytes is intentionally loose until measured baselines are checked in; targets capture the requested steady-state direction.
